description: Asks, on a writable copy, what Database.CreateQueryDef(name, sql) keeps and refuses for SQL texts of many shapes (spacing and case variants, brackets and qualifiers, one and two trailing semicolons, CR/LF, comment forms, an unknown table or column or function, a syntax error, empty, blank and semicolon-only text, every statement family without running it, a declaration, an append, make-table, DDL, crosstab and union text, a reference to another QueryDef, and an embedded accent): after each create, the SQL property exactly, Type and ReturnsRecords; then the Database is closed and reopened and each QueryDef's SQL is read again by name. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.

args.text: SELECT ID AS ID FROM One
SELECT ID FROM One WHERE ID=1 AND ID<>2
SELECT ID INTO Mk FROM One
ALTER TABLE One ADD COLUMN X LONG
TRANSFORM Count(ID) SELECT ID FROM One GROUP BY ID PIVOT ID
SELECT ID FROM One UNION SELECT ID FROM One
PARAMETERS p Long; SELECT ID FROM One WHERE ID = p;
PARAMETERS p Long; UPDATE One SET ID = p
SELECT ID FROM One WITH OWNERACCESS OPTION
SELECT ID FROM One;SELECT ID FROM One
SELECT ID FROM One WHERE ID = [Q0]
